issue: Ranking lines are not the approved wording. The footer on all 1,926 sitemap pages says "Top 1% of all REALTORS® in the Fraser Valley". The homepage meta description, lede and a stat say "10 straight years" in the Medallion Club. The same "10 straight years" sentence is on 197 pages, including the about page. Award image alts add Royal LePage National Top 2%, Top 5% and Top 35 Under 35. No H1 contains a ranking claim. The homepage H2 now uses the approved #1 sentence, and the hero line "Top 1% of Fraser Valley REALTORS®" matches the approved third sentence.
suggested_fix: Put only the three approved sentences in subheadings or body copy, never in an H1. Remove "of all" and "10 straight years". Keep an award badge only if Jared confirms that year.

issue: The live "Latest Google reviews" block is working again (24 reviews rendered, initials on the name line) but prints the feed date as a raw timestamp, for example 2026-04-21T02:39:36.956540Z. All 94 feed dates are ISO timestamps. 66 reviews include a reply, and 58 of those replies contain a first name. Names seen in replies include Kelly, Savannah and Jovita ("Reply from Jared: Thanks Kelly!!" next to K.H.). The static reviews above that block use initials, a calendar date and "Google review".
suggested_fix: Format the feed date as a calendar day before showing it. Do not print a reply that names the client, or replace that name with initials. Leave the static reviews as they are.

issue: The enforced Content-Security-Policy is still only frame-ancestors and base-uri. A fuller policy is now sent as report-only, and it does not allow idx.myrealpage.com or res.myrealpage.com. The browser logged that those scripts and a MyRealPage stylesheet would be blocked if the policy were enforced. Lighthouse best-practices is 78–79 on the map, South Surrey homes and the Altus building page because of third-party Google Ads cookies.
suggested_fix: Add every host the console lists, including the MyRealPage script and style hosts, before the report-only policy is turned on. Load Google Ads only on pages where a conversion is measured.

issue: lastmod is a build day, not the day the page changed: 1,061 URLs on 2026-11-14, 854 on 2026-11-16, 10 on 2026-11-15 and 1 on 2026-11-13. All 202 blog posts have a different visible publish date. Example: /blog.html/115-9072-fleetwood-way-599k-8919895 is datePublished 2026-02-10 and lastmod 2026-11-14.
suggested_fix: Change lastmod only when the page body changes. For a post, keep the published date unless the article itself was edited.

issue: FAQPage JSON-LD is on 1,525 pages. Google has limited FAQ rich results to government and health sites, so this markup is unlikely to earn a rich result. The two broken answers from the last audit now start "Ask Jared Gibbons to set up..." and are grammatical. No empty FAQ answer was emitted.
suggested_fix: Keep the questions as normal text on the page. Drop FAQPage JSON-LD from ordinary listing and neighbourhood pages. Do not add star-rating schema.

issue: Lighthouse still estimates image savings: about 584 KiB on the Meadow Place listing (mobile), about 127 KiB on the homepage mobile and about 290 KiB on the homepage desktop. Largest Contentful Paint itself is in a good range (homepage mobile 2.2 s, listing mobile 2.4 s). One map-page stylesheet is render-blocking by about 150 ms.
suggested_fix: Point cards and the hero at an image size that matches the slot. Keep width and height so the page does not jump.

issue: Both meta descriptions say the unit was leased "for $[***]/mth". The Telegraph Trail page shows "$[***]/mth" as the visible price. Offer schema is no longer output without a price, so the old invalid-Offer finding is fixed, and this placeholder is what replaced it.
suggested_fix: Delete the rent from the sentence, or print the real rent. Do not leave a censored placeholder on a public page or in the description Google reads.

issue: On a phone-width window the listing cards showed "The live listings did not load." The code gives up after 10 seconds. The vendor script was still starting at about 21 seconds, and the cards were then hidden. On a desktop-width window the map frame loaded and the console logged 1,987 listings found.
suggested_fix: Only show the failure if the script actually errors. If a timeout stays, make it longer than the widget's real load time.

issue: The sentence "When you find an area you like, open my active listings" links to /our-listings.html. That page is Jared's own listings, not the homes on the map. The paragraph also talks about municipal parcel lines and about drawing a search boundary in the same breath.
suggested_fix: Say "Jared's own listings" if that is the destination. Point a "homes on this map" link at the map results. Separate the city GIS explanation from the MLS map.

issue: Two external links returned HTTP 404 on a normal GET. The Chilliwack page is linked from /sardis-east-vedder-guide.html. The Surrey Schools page is linked from /blog.html/honoring-indigenous-culture-xwepiteng-elementary-in-south-surrey-8240648. 707 other URLs returned 403 and 411 timed out under a parallel check; those are not confirmed broken. The old BC strata URL is no longer linked from the site.

issue: Semrush Canada, this session: rank 338,929, 1,106 organic keywords, 13 in positions 1–3, 56 in positions 4–10, about 464 organic visits, 96 local-pack keywords, 737 AI-overview keywords, 0 featured snippets. Slightly above the 14 November snapshot. 21 condo-building pages are now in the sitemap, so the old "no building pages" gap is closed.
suggested_fix: Treat this as a content project after the wording fixes. The new building pages are a start, not a ranking result yet.

issue: Both manifest URLs are HTTP 404. /favicon.ico, /favicon.png and /apple-touch-icon.png are now HTTP 200 (favicon.ico was a 404 on 14 November).
suggested_fix: Add a small web app manifest, or remove any link that asks for one.

issue: There is still no terms-of-use page. /terms.html is a real 404. Privacy and the MLS reciprocity disclaimer are in the footer, and /privacy.html is HTTP 200.
suggested_fix: Add a short terms page and link it beside the privacy policy, if Jared wants one.

issue: These three sitemap URLs omit the robots meta tag. They are still indexable. The other pages say index, follow. No page sent an x-robots-tag noindex header.
suggested_fix: Add the same index, follow meta these three pages already imply, so every template matches.

issue: 24 blog H1s are longer than 80 characters. The longest is 104 characters ("Buyer Love Letters Are Dead..."). Title tags themselves stay at or under 60 characters.
suggested_fix: Shorten the on-page headline where it wraps badly on a phone. Leave the title tag as it is.

issue: 53 unique http:// links remain in page HTML (city and business sites). Browsers do not block an http link the way they block an http script. Examples include http://www.clearbrookvillage.info/ and http://www.abbotsfordairport.ca/.
suggested_fix: Move a link to https when the target site has https.

issue: The map console still warns that mapbox-gl.css is missing. Layout shift is now under the Core Web Vitals line (mobile CLS 0.004, desktop CLS 0.051), so this is a display warning rather than a failing score.
suggested_fix: Load the Mapbox stylesheet the widget expects, or accept the vendor warning if the map looks right.

issue: The page says "All 87 written Google reviews" and "5.0 on Google from 94 reviews". The live feed fetched 15 November 2026 reports totalReviewCount 95, returns 94 review records, and 89 of those have written text. The name on each card is initials.
suggested_fix: Pick one count and one source. When the feed is connected, drive the number from that feed and say why a review was left out (the code comment says one Google review is fake).
